title: AUTO WIN,GOD MODE, FLY  FREE!
features:
**TOWER OF HELL SCRIPT ( FREE )**
- Boost & Movement
 Speed Boost: Adjustable walk speed (16–200).
 Super Jump: Adjustable jump power (50–400).
 Fly: Adjustable flight speed.
 Infinite Jump: Jump infinitely in the air.
 Dash: Fast forward dash using the [Q] key.
- Safety & Passives
 God Mode: Permanent healing (laser protection).
 Noclip: Walk through all walls and obstacles effortlessly.
 Invisible: Makes you locally transparent.
 Anti-Void: Prevents you from falling out of the map and catches you.
- Auto Win
 Smart Teleport: Safely teleports you to the 2nd highest point on the map.
 Safety Platform: Automatically spawns a green platform beneath you.
 Customization: Adjustable interval timer (minutes) and Y-Offset (height).
 Rejoin: Automatically switches to low servers.
- Visuals & Camera
 Player ESP: Highlights other players.
 Freecam: Free camera movement (WASD + Q/E) with adjustable speed.
 Spin: Rotates your character (adjustable speed).
- Checkpoint System
 5 Save Slots: Save multiple points simultaneously.
 Keybinds: [C] to save, [V] to teleport.
- Troll & Skins
 Global Skin Copier: Copies ANY Roblox skin (incl. meshes, hair, accessories) perfectly 1:1, using only the username. ( beta )
 Skin History: Saves the last 5 copied skins.
 Visual Name Changer: Changes your name with cool colors (Rainbow, Neon Blue, etc.).
 Anti-AFK: Prevents the 20-minute Roblox kick.
